picks.matchup: New England Patriots vs Seattle Seahawks
picks.analysis: The Seattle Seahawks are favored at home against the New England Patriots. With Mike Macdonald leading a robust defense, the Seahawks might leverage their home-field advantage effectively. New England is under new head coach Mike Vrabel, who may take time to instill his system.

Baltimore has installed Jesse Minter as head coach, noted for his defensive acumen. They are slight road favorites against the Indianapolis Colts, currently in their first year under Shane Steichen. The Colts may face challenges in adapting to a new system.

picks.matchup: Las Vegas Raiders vs Miami Dolphins
picks.analysis: Klint Kubiak's Raiders are favored to win at home against the Dolphins. The Dolphins, coached by Jeff Hafley, are in a competitive AFC East which may translate into a focus on regular season matchups rather than early preseason games.

picks.matchup: Kansas City Chiefs vs Denver Broncos
picks.analysis: The Chiefs, led by veteran coach Andy Reid, often perform well against divisional rivals. Facing them in Week 1, Sean Payton's Broncos might prioritize evaluating new personnel over immediate results, offering the Chiefs a slight edge at home.

In a match between two new-era head coaches, Mike McCarthy's Steelers are favored at home against Kevin Stefanski's Falcons. Pittsburgh's established culture might give them an early-season edge, despite Atlanta's potential offensive innovations.

picks.matchup: Cincinnati Bengals vs Tampa Bay Buccaneers
picks.analysis: With Zac Taylor's Bengals facing the Buccaneers at home, Cincinnati might leverage their offensive prowess. Tampa Bay under Todd Bowles may focus on defensive improvements, though it could take time to see results on the field.
